physicalNotes: Radius 0.885 Jupiter radii from Dugan et al. 2025 (2025ApJ...994L..23D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...994L..23D/abstract): 63,270.4 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Dugan et al. 2025 (2025ApJ...994L..23D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...994L..23D/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.185 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
